title: The dang sticker poisened my review!
text:
The dang sticker poisened my review!. Obviously, this item isn’t going to be a super heavy aluminum given the price. It’s definitely cute, and I’d say a fair price/value. HOWEVER, my biggest pet peeve is manufactures putting stickers on products that won’t come off easily! I’d had to begrudgingly waste time trying to carefully peel off the entire sticker, only to see possibly scratches and gummy residue all over my not so brand new looking item....😑 As to not to have to bother with all the returning dodo, I suppose I will mess with it a bit longer to see if can get it off without damaging it. If not, I will return the product simply because of that. It may be something that vendors don’t think of, but it’s a huge pain in the rear for customers! Hello! How about puttibg this sticker on the bottom of the product, or on the cellophane wrapping it arrived it ?!? Come on people, figure it out! That having been said,
...it truly is a darling product and a fair price. Hopefully someone actually reads this review that has the power to make this simple change and improve the product immensely.

product_metadata.title: The Tin Box Company Coca Cola Holder with 50 Straws, 3.4 x 3.4 x 8.2 inches, Red
description: This beautiful galvanized tin Coca-Cola straw dispenser comes with a window to see the straws inside. The refreshing slogan reminds you of days gone by with a six pack of Coke. It even includes a starter set of 50 straws inside. Made of galvanized tin for years of enjoyment! Snug-fitting lid keeps your inventory of straws secure. Great for kids, parties, and fun! Enjoy the refreshment!
